name: voortgang
description: A VNX mod: shows VNX progress per project in a pane and a status line: live work, open outcomes, open PRs with their review seats, now-tracks and deliverables waiting on a promote.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Comma-separated project ids to leave out. Every other project store under the data root is shown.

data_root.title: Data root
data_root.description: The directory that holds one VNX store per project. A leading ~ is your home directory.

vnx_bin.title: vnx binary
vnx_bin.description: The vnx executable that lists tracks and deliverables. A leading ~ is your home directory.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often the pane and the status line are refreshed; 15 seconds at least.
